citation.authors: He H, Qin Z, Liu K, Wang Z et al

cited_by.title: Intermittent fasting for women, older adults, teenagers and people with heart or thyroid conditions

record.population: 22 randomised trials, 1,287 women with overweight or obesity
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of intermittent fasting trials, with dose-response analysis
record.finding: Intermittent fasting reduced BMI a little (mean difference -0.41, borderline after removing one influential study) and fasting blood glucose (-2.18), with no significant effect on blood pressure. Heterogeneity in the BMI result was high (80%); subgroup findings were based on limited evidence. A frequency of about twice a week looked most favourable in modelling.
record.note: Ethnicity of participants not given in the abstract; I did not read the full text.
